objective: Implement the local dedup service so likely duplicate tasks, meetings, and projects can be detected and surfaced as reviewable candidates.
success_criteria: A dedup service exists for tasks, projects, and meetings.
Task duplicate detection uses canonical dedup key logic when possible.
Project and meeting duplicate detection return reviewable candidates with reasons and scores.
The implementation remains local-only and returns candidates for later review UI instead of silently merging records.
stop_conditions: The task requires UI shell work instead of application-layer duplicate candidate generation.
The task requires schema changes outside the current tables.
The task requires automatic merging instead of reviewable suggestions.
approval_gates: Changing schema instead of implementing on the current foundation
notes: Task dedup must use the canonical task dedup key logic already introduced in the task flow.
Candidate output is for later review UI, not silent mutation.
